01
welcome to the dydra

Welcome to the Dydra Studio User Manual

What is Dydra Studio?

Dydra Studio is a single-page web application that provides a comprehensive interface for:

  • Managing RDF data repositories
  • Executing SPARQL queries
  • Importing and exporting data
  • Creating and managing SPARQL views (saved queries)
  • Managing account and repository metadata
  • Collaborating with other users
02
getting started

Getting Started

Accessing the Application

Dydra Studio is accessed through your web browser. Navigate to the login page at:

URL

https://dydra.com/ui/user

The application will display the login page when you first access it or when you are not authenticated.

Browser Requirements

The application requires a modern web browser with:

  • JavaScript enabled
  • ES6+ JavaScript support
  • History API support (or hash-based routing fallback)

Supported browsers include:

  • Chrome (latest)
  • Firefox (latest)
  • Safari (latest)
  • Edge (latest)

Application Overview

Dydra Studio provides two main interfaces:

  • User App: General user interface for account management, repository operations, SPARQL queries, and data import/export
  • Console: Administrative interface for system-wide management (covered in separate documentation)

This manual focuses on the User App functionality.

Quick Start

To begin using Dydra Studio:

  1. Navigate to https://dydra.com/ui/user in your web browser
  2. Follow the Login instructions to authenticate
  3. Once logged in, you can access all features through the navigation interface

Manual Organization

This manual is organized into the following sections:

  • Login - Authentication and session management
  • Account Operations - Managing account metadata and settings
  • Repository Operations - Creating repositories, importing/exporting data, managing collaborators, and repository deletion
  • View Operations - Creating, editing, executing, and managing SPARQL views
  • Tips and Best Practices - Navigation tips, troubleshooting, and best practices
  • Appendices - File formats, keyboard shortcuts, and glossary

Browser Requirements

The application requires a modern web browser with:

  • JavaScript enabled
  • ES6+ JavaScript support
  • History API support (or hash-based routing fallback)

Supported browsers include Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge (latest versions).

Support

If you encounter any issues or have questions, please contact support at support@dydra.com.
